title: U.S. Geological Survey Mineral Commodity Summaries 2026 Data Release
publisher: U.S. Geological Survey, National Minerals Information Center

aggregationBasis.statedAs: Annual average (as named in each series' statistic, e.g. "Price, annual average")
aggregationBasis.note: Each series' own statistic text says what kind of average it is; trade unit values are customs value divided by quantity.

attribution: Source: National Minerals Information Center, 2026, U.S. Geological Survey Mineral Commodity Summaries 2026 Data Release: U.S. Geological Survey data release, https://doi.org/10.5066/P1WKQ63T.
changesMade: SMPT selected 25 price and unit-value rows for 2021–2025, removed thousands separators and stored the values unchanged, flagging those the USGS marks "Estimated." Percentage changes, indexed values and rankings shown with them are SMPT calculations.
thirdPartyNote: Many of these figures are attributed by the USGS to commercial assessors (for example Argus Media, S&P Global Platts, Benchmark Mineral Intelligence, Asian Metal). SMPT republishes only the USGS annual figures in the public-domain data release, not any assessor's data.
